**Requested before merge**

None. No earlier review findings exist for this PR.

**Not exercised**

The full heavy lanes were not run. They are not a merge condition. I ran the two full-band tests from issue #4315 instead.
The proof uses the ball radius. A wider shank or holder remains subject to the existing verifier checks, as the PR body states.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
